steps.prompt_exact: I sell small products online and I keep wasting photo credits on shots that do not fit the listing. Could you make me a polished one-file offline HTML tool where I enter a product, mood, camera angle, prop, background, and risk note, turn those into draggable shot-list tiles, sort them by priority, and copy or export a production brief for the shoot?
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a complete one-file offline HTML product photo shot-list planner with draggable/sortable tiles, sample data, local storage, copy brief, and download brief export.

code_blocks.content:
Offline product photo shot-list planner

Stop wasting photo credits.

Build draggable listing-shot tiles from the details that actually matter: product, mood, angle, prop, background, priority, and risk note. Sort the list, then copy or download a production brief before shooting or generating.

Create a shot tile

Each tile becomes one usable production instruction.

0 tiles
0 high priority
0 risk notes
0% brief readiness
Drag tiles to reorder. On phones, use the move buttons inside each tile.

Production brief

Generated from your ordered shot list.
